about: P52 T2 holdout: 40 sentences written blind on 2026-10-18 by a subagent that saw only the five hero actions with verb examples, the record shape and the split (30 hero action, 10 enemy-only verb) – no code, no lexicon, no plan, no other sentence set. `wants` = hero actions in sentence order, `family` = first wanted action or `enemy`.
